mapper.select: SELECT * FROM novel_foreshadowing WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM novel_foreshadowing WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status != 'resolved' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY chapter_id
SELECT * FROM novel_foreshadowing WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status != 'resolved' AND deleted = 0 AND chapter_id <= #{currentChapter} ORDER BY chapter_id ASC
SELECT * FROM novel_foreshadowing WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted = 0 AND (chapter_id = #{chapterId} OR resolved_chapter_id = #{chapterId})
mapper.update: UPDATE novel_foreshadowing SET status = 'pending', resolved_chapter_id = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND resolved_chapter_id = #{chapterId} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE novel_foreshadowing fs LEFT JOIN novel_chapter nc ON fs.resolved_chapter_id = nc.id AND nc.deleted = 0 SET fs.status = 'pending', fs.resolved_chapter_id = NULL, fs.update_time = NOW() WHERE fs.project_id = #{projectId} AND fs.status = 'resolved' AND fs.deleted = 0 AND (nc.id IS NULL OR fs.resolved_chapter_id = fs.project_id OR nc.word_count IS NULL OR nc.word_count <= 0 OR nc.content IS NULL OR nc.content = '')
